summary: ternary returns the first value if the input is true and the second if false; both values are evaluated even if not returned.
questions: How do I write an inline if/else in an Ansible variable?
Why does ternary error on an undefined variable in the branch not taken?

answer_card.title: ternary filter
answer_card.answer_md:
`{{ condition | ternary('yes_value', 'no_value') }}` returns the first value if the input is `True`, the second if `False`.

Note: variables used as values are **evaluated even when not returned**, because they're evaluated before being passed in.
